blurb:
A single-day tour of Niagara Falls with Get Going Niagara Tours offers a memorable exploration of this iconic destination. Starting from downtown Toronto near Ripley's Aquarium, your adventure is conducted by one of Niagara's top-rated local tour guides, Micko. As you embark on this drive, Micko provides engaging commentary about Toronto, Ontario, Canada, and Niagara Falls.

The first stop is Maple Leaf Place, where you can enjoy rare Ontario maple sampling . You'll have numerous photo opportunities at breathtaking locations, including the powerful Whirlpool Rapids, The Floral Clock, The Robert Moses Dam and The Lookout Point, where you will enjoy panoramic views of the Niagara River.

The tour price includes tickets for the Hornblower Cruises (in season ( May to October) or the Skylon Tower.

Micko's expert guidance ensures that every moment is both educational and entertaining, making your visit to Niagara Falls an unforgettable adventure.
